title: Safco 2130SL Sit-Stand Desktop Workstation
body_html:
Turn any desk into a sit-stand workstation — no new furniture required.

Part of the Safco Active Collection, this desktop converter retrofits onto worksurfaces up to 3″ thick and lifts your monitor and keyboard for healthier, standing work. Monitor and keyboard heights adjust independently with tool-free lift-and-tilt, and cables route through the arm for a clean, clutter-free desktop.

Key features

  • Retrofits desks and worksurfaces up to 3″ thick
  • Independently adjustable monitor and keyboard heights
  • 26″W platform adjusts 12-1/4″ in height
  • Concealed cable management
  • Holds up to 11 lbs; tool-free lift-and-tilt

Who it’s for

Offices retrofitting existing desks into ergonomic sit-stand workstations without replacing furniture.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
